title: Preview and apply settings on real widgets
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Judge an interface choice on the components I actually use.

**Expected behaviour** · Deliver Profile, Appearance and Workspace pages, a compact About entry and live previews using the real cards. Apply persists, Cancel restores the applied state and Reset previews defaults until applied.

**Scope boundary** · Offer theme, Solid/Glass, density, motion and System/Target cursor.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-036

**Depends on** · WI-031, WI-035, WI-036

**Verify** · Preview and cancel a change, apply a different change, restart and check Home. Verify reset and a visible failed-save state.

**Effort basis** · Composes implemented controls and preference storage.
